title: Set NetworkManager logging level
summary: Change the logging level and/or domains for NetworkManager. This requires administrator privileges.

steps.explain: Set the logging level and/or domains for NetworkManager.
steps.cmd: sudo nmcli general logging level <LEVEL> domain <DOMAINS>

placeholders.name: DOMAINS
placeholders.description: Comma-separated list of domains to log.

rollback.explain: Reset logging to default or previous level.
rollback.cmd: sudo nmcli general logging level INFO

warnings: Setting logging to DEBUG or TRACE can generate a large amount of log data.
